snippet.title: "Mail to the Moon" teaser | Michiños Fofiños
snippet.description:
A princess is trapped in the dark side of the Moon when a space pirate crashes in. 

Both mesmerized, they decide to become pen pals. Follow them to see how their romance develops. Will they be able to get together?

Awards:
- First place in the Sealed with a Kiss Jam 2025.
- "Best SuperIndie" at TLP Tenerife 2025.

Play it in our itch.io: michinosfofinos.itch.io
